description: Heatseeker helps marketing teams inspect ad experiments, imported campaign performance, audience research, and AI personas from their workspace. The app can find workspaces, retrieve experiment results, rank top ads, analyze cross-source evidence, and answer persona-aware marketing questions through ChatGPT so decisions are grounded in customer behavior.
